The '''EU LCS 2014 Summer Split''' was the fourth split of the [[European League of Legends Championship Series]], organized by Riot Games. The season took place from May 20 to August 17, 2014, with the regular season hosted in Berlin and the Playoffs held at gamescom in Cologne, Germany. Ten teams competed in a quadruple round-robin Best-of-One format, followed by a Single Elimination Playoff. The top six teams advanced to the Playoffs, while the bottom two were relegated to the [[LCS/Europe/2015/Spring/Promotion|2015 Spring Promotion Tournament]]. The split featured a $100,000 USD prize pool, with the top three teams qualifying for the [[Worlds 2014|2014 World Championship]].

Between the 2014 Spring and Summer Splits, several roster and structural changes took place in the European LCS. [[Millenium]], [[SUPA HOT CREW]], and [[Copenhagen Wolves]] retained their LCS spots through the [[LCS/Europe/2014/Summer/Promotion|Summer Promotion tournament]], while multiple teams adjusted their lineups ahead of the new split. [[Gambit Gaming]] replaced [[Darien]] with [[Kubon]] in the top lane and added [[niQ]] as their new mid laner, while Copenhagen Wolves strengthened their roster by signing [[Airwaks]] and [[Woolite]].
